original_test_intent: Verify approved Memory Configuration controls persist and restore to the authoritative SPEC while all populated DIMMs train successfully with expected capacity, slots, channels, speed, ECC/RAS and NUMA/interleave behavior and no new memory errors.
original_method: Freeze motherboard/CPU/DIMM serial/slot/channel population, BIOS/microcode and memory defaults; preserve training/RAS logs; define a reversible dependency-aware matrix; change one memory control/group through KVM, save and allow the full approved training deadline; capture retained values, POST codes, DIMM inventory, capacity, speed, ECC and topology plus EDAC/MCA/SEL deltas; invoke Load Defaults and repeat; stop on training loop, disabled DIMM, capacity/speed/topology drift, error delta or no-boot and use owner-controlled known-good/CMOS recovery.
manual_activity: A qualified operator uses BIOS KVM to apply only approved memory controls, observes potentially long training/POST phases, captures each page and performs Load Defaults or physical recovery when authorized.
required_inputs: Complete memory default oracle and safe value matrix with dependencies and training effects
Training/POST timeout, DIMM/capacity/speed/ECC/NUMA/interleave and RAS acceptance
Maintenance/KVM, last-known-good settings, recovery/CMOS ownership and physical access
safety_requirements: Never apply all/random memory values; validate each control against DIMM population and CPU capability
Preserve training, SEL, EDAC/MCA and kernel evidence; do not clear counters or logs
Allow the approved training deadline and distinguish expected retraining from a hang; do not power-cycle early
Stop on disabled/missing DIMM, capacity/speed/topology mismatch, RAS delta, repeated training, POST failure or thermal issue
No automatic reboot, power cycle, retry or CMOS clear
agent_execution_scope: Verify memory identity/population, defaults/matrix, training and topology oracle, maintenance and recovery
Guide manual BIOS phases and collect screenshots, training/POST timing, DIMM inventory, speed/capacity/ECC/NUMA and RAS deltas
Compare retention and restored defaults/effective memory state without issuing the verdict
Do not choose settings, clear evidence, manipulate BIOS/power/CMOS or retry training
engineer_actions: Approve exact Memory Configuration defaults and reversible value/dependency matrix for the installed DIMMs
Approve training deadline, DIMM/topology/performance/RAS acceptance, Load-Defaults scope and recovery
Review screenshots, training, inventory and error evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Interactive BIOS and memory training observation cannot be replaced by SSH. Post-boot inventory/EDAC tools are supporting evidence after operator-controlled saves and reboots.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Operator executes the approved memory matrix and default restoration through KVM while the agent organizes non-destructive DIMM inventory, topology, speed/ECC and RAS evidence at each phase.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Memory Configuration persistence/default cycle and 5/20-minute allocation remain; actual training may exceed the allocation and must follow the engineer-approved timeout, not an automatic retry.

modernized_recommendation.status: HIGH MANUAL MEMORY-CONFIGURATION TRAINING, PERSISTENCE AND DEFAULT-RESTORE TEST
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a DIMM-population-aware incremental matrix and correlate BIOS page state with training time, slot/capacity/speed/ECC/topology and RAS evidence after every reboot and restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds installed-DIMM identity, training deadlines, effective-memory oracle, preserved RAS data and controlled recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A setting can persist while one DIMM is disabled, speed falls back, ECC/interleave changes or corrected errors rise; BIOS screenshots alone miss those outcomes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Unsafe timings, frequency, RAS or interleave controls can cause long retraining, DIMM quarantine, silent capacity loss, instability or no-boot.

project_override_considerations: Auto/default values resolve according to CPU stepping, DIMM mix and firmware build; compare effective trained state as well as menu tokens. Project recipe defaults may intentionally differ from factory defaults and require explicit restoration.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and platform/BIOS/microcode/per-DIMM identity
Memory SPEC/project defaults, selected values, dependencies and expected training effects
Baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots with training/POST timing/codes
Per-phase DIMM slot/channel presence, total capacity, rank, speed, ECC/RAS, NUMA/interleave inventory
Preserved training/SEL/EDAC/MCA/kernel evidence and delta analysis

review_improvement: Adds memory-training and effective DIMM/topology/RAS evidence, preventing a retained setting from concealing disabled DIMMs, fallback speed or new errors and avoiding unsafe automatic cycling during training.
independent_technical_reasoning: Memory settings are accepted only after firmware training, and apparent boot success can mask deconfigured DIMMs or fallback behavior. Therefore evidence must be tied to the exact population and compare slot presence, capacity, speed, ECC/interleave and RAS counters after each approved change and restore. A long training phase must not trigger an automatic power cycle, because interruption can worsen recovery and destroy diagnostic context. Manual KVM supervision is essential.
